editorial:
Imagine you are just hanging out with your best friend when suddenly you have a dead body in the room. That is exactly where you start with this wild ride. You get to follow two lifelong buddies who are completely out of their league, trying to hide a crime while everything that could possibly go wrong actually does. The vibe is a mix of panic and laughs, making you feel like you are right there in the room with them as they make some of the worst decisions possible. It is a fun, messy story that does not take itself too seriously, which is exactly what you want from a dark comedy.

What really works here is the chemistry between the lead actors; they feel like real friends who have known each other forever. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the jokes might feel a bit random. If you love movies where normal people get into huge trouble, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: In the end, the friends think they finally got rid of the evidence, but a huge twist hits when they realize the body was not actually dead the whole time. The person wakes up just as they are about to finish the job. After a chaotic scramble and a few more mistakes, the police arrive. Instead of a clean getaway, the duo ends up getting caught in a hilarious way that proves they were never meant to be criminals.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and chaotic friendships.
